text:
Chris: Heads up — I started seeing a perf churn on MI250 pool where requests in the 800–1400 token range are falling back to the generic CPU path. Profiling attached below, looks like a kernel presence mismatch rather than runtime OOM.

runtime-bot: [alert] 1758890109 - kernel-fallback-rate on mi250-pool exceeded 4% over 5m window (:warning:). See /observability/alerts/1758890109 for details.

Mira: @Chris can you paste the rdw kernel inventory and the request examples? curious if this is a batch-size or seqlen distribution thing. Also are these streaming or non-streaming requests?

Chris: Non-streaming. Quick inventory I pulled from mi250-03:
```
$ rdwctl kernel list --node mi250-03 --model gpt-3.5-like
mi250-03: mi250-int8-v1 (seqlen <= 512) - available
mi250-03: mi250-int8-v2 (seqlen <= 1024) - MISSING
mi250-03: mi250-int16 (seqlen <= 2048) - available
mi250-03: mi250-opaque (generic) - available
```
So router tries to pick the int8-v2 path for these mid seqlens but falls back because the kernel object can't be found. Noticed it after last night's rollout of autotune pack.

Kenji: Can you share the pprof flame? even a top-10 is fine — want to confirm whether the slow bit is kernel selection or the generic kernel itself.

Chris: Top flame (sampled over 60s) — most time is in generic_dispatch -> generic_kernel_exec, with a small spike during kernel_lookup:
```
Samples 60s
40% generic_kernel_exec
12% generic_dispatch
8% kernel_lookup (rocm_catalog.c)
6% kv_cache_miss_handler
rest various
```
So kernel_lookup shows up but the heavy stuff is the generic kernel. That supports a missing-kernel route.

Mira: Sounds like the autotuner produced a kernel target that didn't get pushed to some nodes. Two action lanes: 1) make router tolerant (soft-fallback) so it prefers available int8-v1 or int16 instead of generic CPU; 2) fix inventory push. For (1) we can change conditional routing rule to prefer same-arch non-generic kernels.

Devon: Agree. We should also add a metric for "kernel_inventory_mismatch" per node so we can alert earlier. Right now runtime-bot only sees fallback rate which is too late.

Kenji: Quick working patch idea — update routing policy to include an explicit arch-aware fallback map. Diff-ish:
```
- "route_candidates": ["mi250-int8-v2","mi250-opaque"]
+ "route_candidates": ["mi250-int8-v2","mi250-int16","mi250-int8-v1","mi250-opaque"]
+ "fallback_policy": "prefer_arch_neighbors"
```
If candidate not present, pick next with same arch/quants before generic. Minimal change and safe.

Chris: I'll open a small PR for the routing policy change and a separate ticket for the kernel push verification. Can someone run a quick soak on mi250-canary after PR?

Mira: @Kenji can you add a temporary rule on the canary to force-route mid seqlen requests to int16 (to avoid immediate user impact) while push-propagation is investigated?

Kenji: done — pushed a policy override to mi250-canary that maps 512<seqlen<=2048 -> mi250-int16. Ran a short synthetic load: fallback -> generic dropped from 5.2% -> 0.7% on canary.

Devon: Also please add kv_cache_miss ratio to the per-route dashboard (suggested name: route.kernel.kv_cache_miss_ratio) — it correlates with these lookups and will help root cause if cache churn is causing misses.

Chris: Reproducer for infra team (small script):
```
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST $RDW_ENDPOINT/generate -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":1200}' &
done
```
Run against mi250-canary to validate route changes.

Mira: FYI the autotuner manifest had an id mismatch for int8-v2 (manifest_id vs deployed_id), so the push likely skipped nodes that already had older id. I'll follow up with the onboarding script fix.

Devon: Action items:
- Chris: PR for routing policy change + run soak on canary (ETA today)
- Kenji: temporary canary override applied (done) + monitor
- Mira: follow up PR for autotuner manifest validation
- Infra: add kernel_inventory_mismatch metric + kv_cache_miss_ratio to dashboard

Chris: Thanks. I'll post results from the soak and link the PR here. :thumbsup:

runtime-bot: [info] Created incident follow-up ticket IN-17588902 for kernel inventory and routing policy updates.
